tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs bzhugs so// bde gshegs kun dngos bla ma brgyud par bcas/ /lhag pa'i lhar gyur snying po kyai rdo rje/ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs bka' srung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /kun la phyag 'tshal thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ /smin byed mthar thug lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /rim pa bzhi yis 'jug cing dbang bskur tshul/ /zab pa'i don mchog bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /rang nyid dran pa gso phyir bri bar bya/ /'di la sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi/ mjug gi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ ras bris sam/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du mchod gtor bum pa gnyis rdo rje dril bu dang / gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dang tshogs 'khor gyi chas rnams legs par bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / byin dbab/ gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms la/ bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bsgrubs la mchod cing bstod nas/ bum pa sta gon byas la/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba bzhin bdag 'jug rgyas par bya/ dbang blang ba'i yul gyi ye shes pa bla ma'i lus la bcug nas/ gtor ma btang / tshogs la rol/ lhag ma'i cho ga spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la 'jug pa dang / dbang bskur ba gnyis kyi dang po la phyi nang gi 'jug pa gnyis kyi phyi 'jug ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du yongs su sbyangs pa'i slob ma gcig nas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar kha yar bas khrus byas pa gral la 'khod nas maṇ+ḍal phul ba la/ bla mas khyed rnams dpal kyai rdo rje'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga zhu bar 'dod pa de shin tu legs te/ de'ang dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing / snyed pa la'ang snying po blang dgos/ mi lus thob pa'ang mi rtag ste nam 'chi cha med/ shi ba na 'khor ba las mi dge ba'i dbang gis skyes nas sdug bsngal du mas gdungs par 'gyur bas/

de las thar pa'i myang 'das cis kyang thob par byed dgos shing / de la'ang don gnyis mthar phyin pa sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa gzhan la med pas de kho na don du gnyer bya yin la/ de thob par byed pa'i thabs theg chen gyi lam dang / de las kyang dka' ba med cing bde ba'i lam gyis myur du phyag rgya chen po sngon du byed pa gsang sngags kyi lam bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa nyid yin la/ de bsgom pa'i sngon du'ang dbang byin rlabs 'gro dgos te/ dbang gis rgyud smin par ma byas na bsgrubs kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ bla ma mnyes par ma byas shing / /dbang rnams thob par mi 'gyur bar/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa ni/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi zhal nas/ gsang sngags snyan sogs ma chad pa zhes pas snyan brgyud bzhi ni dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdam ngag gi sar ka ma log pa/ mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim pa bzhi las 'di dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa yin/ de la'ang rgyu dus/ lam dus/ 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa gsum las/ 'di rgyu dus kyi yin/ de la yab kyi phyogs dang / yum gyi phyogs gnyis las/ 'di yab kyi phyogs yin/ de gnyis ka la yang / dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang / byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga gnyis gnyis las 'di phyi ma yin/ de la dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro dgos la/ dkyil 'khor la dbye na/ gang zag dbang po tha ma sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa can la yid ches pa ras bris kyi dang / 'bring po thugs phyag mtshan gyi dang / gsung yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor la yid ches pa'i ngor rdul mtshon gyi dang / yang rab rang lus gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor mos pa brtan pa'i ngor lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs pa dang gsum las/ bcos ma gnyis spangs nas/ zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar bgyi/

de la bsnyen pa dang sa chog mi dgos te/ sngon du slob dpon rang gi lus 'khor lo lnga'i bdag nyid kyi lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang gzhal yas khang du gdod nas grub par shes pa nyid bsnyen pa dang / phyi'i dkyil 'khor la mi ltos pa'i phyir ro/ /lha rang bzhin gyis grub pas sta gon mi dgos la/ de ltar slob ma'i lus la yang grub par shes shing / sngon du smin par byas zin pas slob ma sta gon mi dgos pa'i phyir bum pa sta gon tsam la bsten nas cho ga gzhan rnams bsgrubs zin nas/ da slob ma 'jug pa yin pas/ nga'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor pho brang lnga'i dbus nas gtso bo thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i pho brang rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin/ mdun gyi 'di de las sprul pa yin/ de gnyis tha dad med pa la sems can thams cad kyi don du dbang slang snyam pa gyis la snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyor la lad mo gyis shig ces brjod la/ bdag med ma zhes sogs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ sems bskyed/ khyad par gyi sdig pa bshags pa ni/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang du gyur pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang / so so thar pa'i sdom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang / khyad par du bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha la ma gus pa dang / mchod pa dang gtor ma la ma brtson pa dang / bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la g.yel ba la sogs pa sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dang / nyes pa dang / ltung ba'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/

mi sbed do/ /slan chad kyang gcod cing sdom lags so/ /zhes lan gsum gyi rjes la/ de ltar mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so/ /zhes lan gcig brjod do/ /de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / gdong g.yogs bcing / me tog phreng ba gtad/ las thams cad pa'i chu dang a mṛ tas bsang / bdud rtsi lce la bzhag pas lus thams cad gang bar byin gyis brlab/ zla dang rdo rje la kun rdzob dang don dam byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / gsang bar gdams la/ nang du gzhug go /gnyis pa nang du 'jug pa ni/ de nas gang gi drin gyis dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i gtso/ /bla ma dpal ldan he ru ka /khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ dam la gzhag pa bzhi thun mong du lan re brjod/ bdag 'jug bzhin ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab/ de nas byin gyis brlab pa dngos la bzhi las/ dang po rgyud kyi rim pa ni bdag 'jug dang 'dra bar 'byung ba bzhi'i sa bon dang bcas pa gsal btab nas/ dpon slob gnyis kas slob ma'i spyi bor pad+ma 'dab brgyad nyi zla dang bcas pa'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom/ de'i steng gi cha la bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang / sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i bar gsal gdab/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la bstim/ de la mchod bstod mos gus drag po bya/ de nas rim bzhin zhu nas thim pas mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od du zhu nas bdag la thim par bsam shing / de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang bdag dbyer med du gyur nas bde stong gi ngang la bzhag go /gnyis pa sngags kyi rim pa ni/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa yig dang / /rtsa dbu ma gsal gdab/ steng 'og gi rlung cung zad kha sbyar bas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar/

lte ba'i a thung bsros nas me cher 'bar bas lte ba'i 'khor lo'i me'i 'od kyis lhang lhang bsgom/ de nas me de dbu ma nas zhugs/ rim pa bzhin snying ga mgrin pa/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo rnams khengs pas gzhan rnams kyi rgyud la 'gro 'ong byas nas/ slar 'dus te bdag la zhugs pas haṃ zhu/ byang chub kyi sems kyis spyi bo'i 'khor lo rnams khengs rim pa bzhin du lte ba'i bar du khengs/ lus thams cad bde ba 'khril ba la shes pa gtad/ des ngag gi dri ma dag par bsgom/ gsum pa ye shes kyi rim pa ni/ ngag gi sems kyi bde nyams de/ mdun gyi bar snang la bton la/ dbyibs dang kha dog gang yang ma rnyed/ rang gi lus 'di me long la has btab pa bzhin yal gyis yal bar bsam zhing / bde stong la sems gtad/ des sems kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ bzhi pa gsang ba'i rim pa ni/ rang dang snang ba thams cad spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag ste/ de'ang rgyu med pa'i tshul gyis mnyam par gzhag go /des lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs par bsam/ de bzhi ka rol mo'i sgra dang gu gul bdug pa/ ngag tu aṣ+ṭa dang ā li brjod pa rnams re re bya/ bstan par bya ba thugs kyis gtso bo la me tog dor/ gdong dbye/ me tog bcing / thar pa chen po'i sogs dang / rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i bdag /ces sogs kyis dkyil 'khor bstan te ngo sprad pa ni/ phyi dbyibs dang / nang lus kyi dkyil 'khor ngo sprod pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gzhal yas khang phyi dang / lha gtso bo nas rim gyis ngo sprod/ gnyis pa rten dang brten pa mngon rtogs bzhin ngo sprad nas/ de rnams kyang lus kyi rtsa la gnas pa lus rtsa'i dang / hūm̐ am̐ dang pū dza sogs kyi yi ge'i dbyibs su gnas pa yi ge'i dang / de rnams kyi nang na khams gnas pa khams bdud rtsi dang / de thams cad la khyab pa snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor yin te/

de ltar phyi nang gnyis ka gnyis su med cing / de thams cad slob dpon gyi lus la tshang bar yod la khyed rang rnams kyi lus la'ang tshang ste/ sam+bu ṭar/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung / /gzhu yi dbyibs su yang dag gnas/ /sum mdor yang ni me yin te/ /gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbyibs su gnas/ /lte bar yang ni chu yin te/ /zlum po'i gzugs su yang dag gnas/ /snying kar yang ni sa nyid de/ /kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do/ /zhes dang / kyai rdo rjer/ dbugs rgyu zhes bya'i rig pa 'di/ /dur khrod ces ni mngon par brjod/ /ces dang / gang phyir lus las byung ba nyid/ /lha zhes mngon par brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / bla ma'i man ngag gis/ mig la sogs par gti mug sogs/ /rdo rje gsum ni gnas gsum dgod/ /yul drug lha mo drug yin te/ /tshigs brgyad rkang mthil spyi bo gnyis/ /khro bo bcu yi ngo bor bsam/ /zhes dang / saṃ pu ṭar/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha gar brjod pa nyid/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni byang chub sems/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni brtag par bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar bsam ste/ gang gi drin gyis sogs kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag byas nas/ rang la gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma'i drin las byin rlabs kyi rim pas gsal bar byas pa yin snyam du mos te/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhes sogs bdag 'jug ltar brjod do/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la bzhi las dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ bla ma la gdan gsum tshang bar ma shes na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo mi 'phrod pas shes par byed dgos te/ de'ang bla ma'i gzugs sogs phung po lnga dang / pho brang lnga'i gtso bo yab lnga sangs rgyas kyi gdan/ nang gi skye mched dang / rnam shes brgyad dang / skye mched kyi lha drug dang / sa'i snying po sogs byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/

sa sogs 'byung ba lnga dang / yum lnga ni rig ma'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched drug dang gzugs rdo rje sogs lha mo'i gdan yin la/ tshigs brgyad spyi bo rkang mthil gshin rje gshed sogs khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan/ de rnams ni rnam par dag pa'i dbang du byas nas gdan gsum tshang bar gzhag pa yin la/ byin gyis rlob pa phrin las kyi dbang du byas nas gdan gsum tshang bar brtsi na/ rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur bas ma dag pa'i phung po dang / nyon mongs pa lnga sku dang ye shes lngar byin gyis rlob pa'i dbang du byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ bkra shis la sogs pa'i phrin las mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ rdo rje'i glu blangs pas tshad med pa bzhi'i chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po dang lngar byin gyis rlob pa rig ma'i gdan/ mchod pa dang bstod pa la sogs pa mdzad pas lha mo'i gdan/ bgegs skrod bsrung ba dang dgug gzhug la sogs pa'i phrin las mdzad pa khro bo khro mo'i gdan no/ /de ltar zhib tu brtsis na dkyil 'khor bzhi ka la gdan gsum tshang bas de lta bu'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba zhu snyam du mos pa gyis zhes brjod la/ maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba gdab pa nas gzung nas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yan chad bdag 'jug dang phal cher 'dra la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni rig pa'i dbang lnga la lha rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bsgom pa dang / dmigs pa rgya che chung gis pho brang lnga'i lha thams cad dam/ gtso bo lnga'am/ phyi'i he ru ka gcig pu la dbang len par bsam pa gang 'thad byed pa yin no/ /mtha' rten gyi skabs su dkyil 'khor ni/ lam byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun mtshon par byed pa yin zhing / phyi nang gi lha rnams ni 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yon tan phrin las mtshon pa yin la/

de thams cad kyang sngar bstan pa ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ngo zhes pas/ dkyil 'khor/ lha/ slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid gsum bstan zhing / de ltar shes pas phyi nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la lhas lha mchod pa'i tshul du/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod par gyis shig ces brjod pa'i rjes gnang dang / ma rig pa'i rab rib dang bral ba'i blo gros kyi mig gis chos thams cad me long gi gzugs brnyan dang / dril bu'i sgra ltar gsal la rang bzhin med pa rten 'brel tsam dang / nam mkha' lta bu mtshan nyid thams cad kyi stong pa rang bzhin med pa mnyam par shes pas sems can thams cad kyi dbang po dang / khams dang / bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa rgyun mi 'chad par bskor zhing / phrin las rnam pa bzhis gang la gang 'dul du sems can gyi don rgyun chad med par gyis shig ces chos 'chad pa dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang byin nas/ des khyed rnams kyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma sprul pa'i sku lus bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa gshin pa dang 'dra/ bsrung bya rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba dang / bsgom bya'i lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang / lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum/ grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med/ lus brda lnga bsdus rtse mo mnan pa/ ngag brda ka la sha a/ 'da' ka ma gong du 'pho ba/ 'bras bu sprul sku rang bzhin lhun grub thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin zhes ngo sprad do/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang la/ gsol ba gdab pa nas lung bstan pa'i bar bdag 'jug ltar byas la/ khyed kyis yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du bla ma longs sku las gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag dpe sa bon skyon med btab pa dang 'dra/ dam tshig rlung gi sbyor bas srog rtsol 'gog pa dang /

lam bdag byin rlabs sgom/ lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi/ grub mtha' ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ lus brda mtheb srin e la rig byed dang / ngag brda ya ra la wa/ 'da' ka ma 'od gsal/ 'bras bu longs sku dang rang bzhin lhun grub 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ dngos gzhi bdag 'jug dang 'dra la/ mtha' rten la gsum gyi/ gsang ba'i ye shes la bslab pa dang / 'dod chags zhes sogs kyi rjes su dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa gsum la nam du'ang ma bral bar gyis zhes brjod la phyag byed du bcug ste/ lus dbul la dam tshig bsgrag pa bdag 'jug ltar byas nas/ de ltar khyed kyis nan tan du byas na 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yon tan phrin las thams cad 'bad med du thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung dang / de'i don du lam gyi gnas skabs su dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs thams cad 'bad pas nyams su blang ba la brtson par gyis shig ces pa lam gyi dbugs dbyung bya ste/ khyed kyis kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma chos kyi sku las shes rab ye shis kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag dpe chu lud drod tshad 'dzom pa dang 'dra/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo/ dam tshig thig le mi nyams par bsrung ba/ lta ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dga' ba bzhi/ grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba/ lus brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ ngag brda e waṃ ma ya/ 'da' ka ma rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba/ 'bras bu chos sku rang bzhin lhun grub thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa yin zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bdag 'jug dang 'dra la/ gsol ba gdab pa'i skabs su/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas/

/dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog gyur pa'i/ /bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis bya zhing / mjug tu khyod kyis don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku la dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dpe lo thog phun sum tshogs pa smin pa dang 'dra/ lam rdo rje rba rlabs gsum sgom pa la dbang / dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa dang nyams su len pa la dbang / lta ba chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa de kho na nyid gsum/ grub mtha' rgya che ba bde stong gi dngos grub/ lus brda mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ ngag brda oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'da' ka ma phyag rgya chen po ni 'pho ba/ 'bras bu shin tu rnam dag ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin no/ /zhes brjod do/ /dbang rgyas pa blang ba'o// //'bring du blang ba ni/ thog mar mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dbang rgyas pa gnyis ji lta ba bzhin byas la/ de nas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /zhes pas bum dbang thob par bsam/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas gsang ba'i dbang thob par bsam/ dga' bster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ /zhes pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes brjod pas/ dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gang du dbang gang thob dri ma gang dag pa la sogs pa'ang dran par bya'o//

//dbang bsdus pa blang ba ni/ byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gcig la dbang bzhi rdzogs par len pa'i lugs te/ thog mar mchod pa dang gsol ba gdab pa sngar dang 'dra bar bya ste/ de nas gtso bo lngas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis lha thams cad dam/ gtso bo lnga'am/ thugs rdo rje la 'khor lo lnga'i gnas su dbang bskur bas dbang bzhi ka thob par bsam zhing dri ma bzhi dag par mos pa bya ste/ 'di ni rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po pad+ma badz+ra'i dgongs pa dang mtshungs par bzhed do/ /de ltar dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las phyi'i he ru ka la mi bskyod pa/ nang gi gtso bo lnga la rdo rje sems dpa'/ pho brang lnga'i 'khor rnams la rang rang gi gtso bo dang / skye mched rnams la/ rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i rigs bdag dang / gau rī la sogs pa drug la mi bskyod/ rnam snang / rin 'byung / snang mtha'/ snang mdzad/ gshin rje gshed la snang mdzad/ pad+ma mthar byed la snang mtha'/ gzhan rnams la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga la dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag bsdus te khas blang ba/ lus dang yon dbul ba/ rjes kyi mchod bstod/ gtor ma gtong ba/ bzod par gsol ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ bsngo ba dang / smon lam bkra shis la sogs pa mjug gi cho ga rnams spyi dang 'dra bar nyams su blang ngo / dbang rdzas/ bum pa/ mig dar/ me tog phreng ba ma gtogs pa thams cad dmigs pa kho nas mdzad do/ /rdo rje 'chang chen/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ mthu stobs dbang phyug shar phyogs nag po pa/ ḍa ma ru pa/ a ba dhu ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ shākya ye shes dang / se mkhar chung ba/ rje btsun dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun rnam gnyis/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ dkon mchog dpal dang / kun bsod dang / bla chen kun dga' blo gros las 'ongs pa'o/ /gzhan yang / gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po las/ tshogs bsgom/ nyan chen/ gzhon nu dpal las so/

/gsum pa 'phags pa/ 'phags rgyal/ bzang po dang / bzhi pa dkon mchog dpal dang / bsod nams las/ legs rgyud zab mo dbang mchog bskur ba'i tshul/ /bla ma'i gsung dang snyan rgyud tho yig dang / /brjed byang sna tshogs gsung ngag cha lag las/ /legs par btus te gus pa'i yid kyis sbyar/ /'di la nongs gang bla ma lhar bcas dang / /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dge bas bdag gzhan lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchog /mngon du gyur nas sangs rgyas sar bgrod shog /smin byed mchog gis bskur ba'i tshul zab pa bas ches zab pa'i don zhib tu sbyar ba 'di nyid/ rang bzo spangs te dpa' bo'i lo/ nag pa'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin par/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rang gzhan gyi don du myur bar sbyar ba las/ cung zad ma tshang ba phyis chos rje grag phug pa'i gsung bzhin/ ma tshang ba bsabs nas zhus chen bgyis pa'o/ /samāp+tā// //gcig legs par zhus dag/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 bla ma dam pa/ kye rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
